response.text:
I can do that — I just need a few things before I create the recurring event and invite people.

Please either paste the note here or confirm the details below (copying or saying “use note” after you paste it):

Required
- Event title (if not in the note)
- Attendees (who is “everyone”? a mailing list, everyone on a specific team, or all org members?) — list emails or a group alias
- First meeting date, start time, and duration
- Time zone (or confirm it’s your default time zone)
- Recurrence rule (e.g., weekly on Tuesdays, every other week, monthly on the 1st, etc.)
- Recurrence end (date or number of occurrences, or “no end”)

Optional (default choices I’ll assume unless you say otherwise)
- Location or “virtual” (if virtual, should I add conferencing and which provider? e.g., Google Meet/Zoom)
- Organizer (your calendar or another account)
- Attendee RSVP requirement (required vs optional)
- Reminder(s) and timing (e.g., 10 minutes before)
- Visibility/privacy (busy vs free, private)
- Any agenda text to include in the invite body

Important: creating the event will send calendar invites and is externally visible. I won’t create or send anything until you paste the note (or confirm details) and explicitly tell me “Yes, create the event now.”

What would you like me to do next?
